scripts.check:offline: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):[p.join(d,e.name)]);const bad=walk('public').filter(f=>/(index|mobile)\.html$|\/(css|js)\//.test(f)).filter(f=>/(src|href)=[\x22\x27]https?:|@import\s+url\([\x22\x27]?https?:|fonts\.googleapis|cdn\./.test(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')));if(bad.length){console.error('External dependencies in:',bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('No external CDN dependencies in public/')"
